meta.source: Extracted from https://pierresegonne.com/ (style.css, css/posts.css, inline styles, computed styles) on 2026-11-23. Tokens marked PROPOSED are recommendations for the redesign, not values from the reference. Typefaces: the reference names Montserrat (sans) and Merriweather (serif); this system uses IBM Plex Sans, Serif and Mono instead, at the reference's sizes, weights and roles.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind all reading content. The content area is always plain white: colour lives only in the frame (masthead and footer bands).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on paper (12.6:1). Default text colour for paragraphs, lists, footer text.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings h1–h3 and post titles in the listing, on paper (15.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-max
tokens.usage: Listing page title ("Posts") and ::selection text. Use sparingly: one element per page.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, post meta, h4, blockquote text and blockquote rule, on paper (5.7:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px separators between posts in the listing; ::selection background. Borders, never boxes or shadows.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px bottom border of the footer band.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Fallback colour of the masthead and footer bands, shown under/before the frame photo. Ground for all on-night text.

tokens.name: night-deep
tokens.usage: Dominant tone sampled from the masthead photo (ultramarine, #000040–#000090 range). Use as the solid band colour if you skip the photo.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The ONE hot accent: the site name in the masthead, nothing else. On night 3.0:1 — passes only as large text (28px); keep it ≥24px and prefer weight 400 over 300.

tokens.name: ember-glow
tokens.usage: Average of the red filaments sampled from the footer photo (~8% of its pixels). Decorative only — never text.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Tagline under the site name, on night (13.2:1).

tokens.name: nav-on-night
tokens.usage: Navigation links on the masthead, on night (11.4:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: REFERENCE link colour in body text and footer. FLAG: 3.99:1 on paper — fails WCAG AA for 18px body text. Replace with link-accessible.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: REFERENCE hover/active link colour, and nav link colour under 640px. FLAG: 3.29:1 on paper, 4.03:1 on night — fails AA. Replace with link-accessible-hover.

tokens.name: link-accessible
tokens.usage: PROPOSED link colour on paper (5.4:1). Same hue as the reference blue, darker.

tokens.name: link-accessible-hover
tokens.usage: PROPOSED hover/active link colour on paper (6.7:1). Pair with an underline on hover so the change does not rely on colour alone.

tokens.name: code-border
tokens.usage: 1.25px border around highlighted code blocks (GitHub-light palette).

tokens.name: code-surface
tokens.usage: Subtle code background (GitHub-light canvas-subtle). The reference draws code on white; use this for inline code if you add a tint.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Code keywords, on paper (5.4:1).

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Code strings and multiline comments, on paper (12.8:1).

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Code comments, on paper (4.55:1 — just passes).

tokens.name: syntax-entity
tokens.usage: Code entities / function names, on paper.

tokens.name: syntax-constant
tokens.usage: Code operators and constants, on paper.

tokens.name: grid-low
tokens.usage: Carbon-aware widget: low-intensity state (text, dot, toggle-on track). On night 4.35:1 — fine at 12–13px only because it is paired with a dot and a label.

tokens.name: grid-medium
tokens.usage: Carbon-aware widget: moderate-intensity state, on night (5.2:1).

tokens.name: grid-high
tokens.usage: Carbon-aware widget: high-intensity TEXT. FLAG: 2.7:1 on night — too dark for small text; use grid-high-dot for text too.

tokens.name: grid-high-dot
tokens.usage: Carbon-aware widget: high-intensity dot, on night (3.6:1 — OK for a non-text indicator).

tokens.name: grid-unknown
tokens.usage: Carbon-aware widget: dot and toggle track before the zone is detected / when off.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: site-name
styles.usage: The site name, in ember, on the masthead band.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: One-line role under the name, in on-night; pulled up 5px (margin-top: -5px).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: h1 of a page or article, ink-strong. Line-height 1.7 is loose for two-line titles; consider 1.25.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.sample: Trains in Europe, experiences, tips and tricks
styles.usage: h2 in articles and the post titles in the listing, ink-strong.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: h4, in ink-muted (the only grey heading).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I am interested in understanding how learning processes can uncover hidden mechanics of the universe.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, lists, footer, in ink. 15px vertical rhythm between paragraphs. PROPOSED: 1.6 line-height for a serif at this size.

styles.name: date-italic
styles.usage: Date under an article title, ink-muted, italic.

styles.name: post-meta
styles.usage: Date above each post title in the listing, ink-muted.

styles.name: blockquote
styles.sample: A picture is worth a thousand words.
styles.usage: Pull quotes: ink-muted italic, 2px ink-muted rule on the left, 1.8em/0.8em margin.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code. 12px against 18px body is small; PROPOSED 15px.

styles.name: status-value
styles.usage: Carbon-aware widget: detected zone, on night.

styles.name: status-label
styles.usage: Carbon-aware widget: intensity text and toggle label, on night.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tagline pulled up under the name (-5px).

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Container side gutter; gap above each post in the listing; mobile nav link spacing.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: The base rhythm: paragraph margins, heading bottom margins, gap after a post title, avatar gap.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Masthead and footer vertical padding; gap between nav links.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: List indent; article h1 top margin.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Gap between the main column and the footer band.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Share buttons — the only small controls on content.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Avatar image corners.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Grid-aware toggle track.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status dots, toggle knob, About-page portrait.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Share buttons only. The rest of the site uses no shadows.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the single column, including 10px gutters on each side.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Resulting text measure: ~80 characters of 18px IBM Plex Serif.

tokens.name: breakpoint-narrow
tokens.usage: Single breakpoint: masthead centres, nav drops below the name, heading line-height tightens to 1.4.

tokens.name: main-min-height
tokens.usage: Keeps the footer band low on short pages.

tokens.name: masthead-image-height
tokens.usage: Height of the reference masthead photo (1134×129, ≈8.8:1, background-size: cover). The band itself is content height: 20px padding + name + tagline.
